info.listText: View all your in-game friends. Tap a friend to visit their profile and see their tower stats.
info.requestsText: Accept or reject incoming friend requests. The badge on the tab shows how many requests are waiting.

mail.emptySubtitle: When someone sends you a message it'll show up here
mail.emptySentSubtitle: Messages you send to other players will appear here

info.inboxText: Receive messages from any player in the game. Messages are sorted from newest to oldest.
info.unreadText: Unread messages are highlighted in green. Tap a message to open and read it — it will be marked as read automatically.
info.deleteText: You can delete any message after reading it. Deletion is permanent.
info.costText: Sending a message to another player costs 100 coins. Find any player's profile to send them a message.

autopark.title: Autopark
autopark.tagline: Machines allow you to earn more and develop faster

taxi.name: Taxi
taxi.short: More gem exchanges & XP per lobby visitor
taxi.desc: Each taxi adds +1 free {gem} exchange per day and gives +1,000 {xp} for each elevator visitor.

forklift.name: Forklift
forklift.short: Faster sales & bonus XP per listing
forklift.desc: Each forklift {speed} speeds up sales by 1% and gives +5,000 {xp} per listed product.

armored_truck.name: Armored Truck
armored_truck.short: Boosts base profit & XP before all multipliers
armored_truck.desc: Each armored truck boosts base {coin} profit by 5% and base {xp} by 10%. These bonuses apply before all other multipliers.

delivery_truck.name: Delivery Truck
delivery_truck.short: Faster deliveries & bonus XP per purchase
delivery_truck.desc: Each truck {speed} speeds up delivery by 1% and gives +5,000 {xp} per purchased product.

bus.name: Bus
bus.desc: Each bus adds 5 {visitor} slots to the elevator and boosts {coin} tips by 5%.

info.whatText: The autopark is a fleet of vehicles that passively boost your hotel's performance. Each vehicle type provides a unique bonus — buy up to 10 of each.
info.truckText: Each armored truck increases base production profit by +5% and base XP by +10%. These bonuses apply before all other multipliers.
info.speedText: Forklifts reduce sell time by 1% each. Delivery trucks reduce delivery time by 1% each. Both also give +5,000 XP per action.
info.lobbyText: Taxis add +1 free gem exchange per day and +1,000 XP per visitor. Buses add +5 visitor slots and +5% tip income each.
